perpetual_loop_seam — GENERATIVE loop op

• Data kinds: rgbvideo → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.perpetual_loop_seam(video: 'np.ndarray') -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import perpetual; perpetual.perpetual_loop_seam(video: 'np.ndarray') -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsgenerative.get("perpetual_loop_seam"))

Usage

Quantifies the seam of a looping video as numbers (table).

seam = difference from the last frame → the first frame, typical = median of the frame-to-frame differences. In a seamless video ratio = seam / typical is close to 1 (the last crossing cannot be told apart from the other crossings). The point to read here is that 1, not 0, is the right answer -- 0 would mean "the motion has stopped".
